'''Pokémon, The Johto League Champions''' is the opening theme song for the {{pmin|Italy|Italian-language}} dub of the [[S04|fourth season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from [[EP158]] to [[EP209]].

The opening animation featured footage from the fourth English opening, [[Born to Be a Winner]], and clips from various episodes of the season.
